body: Built NORTHSTAR §15 end to end (chosen over §16/§17/§19.5 via a direct question, since the S170 sprint's actionable backlog was otherwise fully done). Camera lock: new C toggle freezes the yaw/pitch orbit angle (the pivot already always follows my_owner's hero) -- zoom stays free while locked, per real-MOBA convention. Fog of war: client-side visual only (not real server-side vision culling, per the spec's own explicit scope decision) -- new ARENA_VISION_RADIUS (16.0 * phi, ~25.89, sized against the current golden-ratio-scaled node spacing) hides enemy heroes beyond that radius entirely (model, health bar, name, hover-target). Allies and jungle creeps always visible. README updated. Build clean, full suite green (607/607), live-verified 6s under Xvfb with no crash. REDGARDEN c45fb6b (+ CHANGELOG same commit range).
title: S170-196: camera lock + fog of war, NORTHSTAR §15
